text: {"question":"What is the prior range for the reionization transition redshift parameter, and how does this range relate to the small‑scale regime where dark matter self‑interactions are most relevant?","reference_answer":"The prior on the transition redshift, \(z_{\rm t}\), is flat between 1 and 10. This range corresponds to the epoch when the Universe is already well into the matter‑dominated era, a period that overlaps with the small‑scale structure formation where dark matter self‑interactions, particularly low‑energy scattering and dark‑pion emission, can influence halo properties."}
